scenario_description:
Objective: Prevent an avoidable stair-access disruption at the start of the November 15 Mountain Songs matinee.
Emerging Need: Kunsang’s planned attendance makes the stored ground-floor preference relevant before purchase; the later paid balcony order creates a concrete conflict.
Decision Context: Three purchased seats cover Sahana, Nima and Kunsang; Pema has separate admission. The box office offers a no-charge exchange, supported by Kunsang’s privately shared preference.
Consequence: The final checkpoint records the actual missed opening due to the balcony arrangement. Earlier exchange or reconsidering attendance remains useful after the advertised exchange hold; later assistance may improve the remaining performance.

parameter.subject: Nov 15 Mountain Songs matinee: balcony sale opens
parameter.body: Discount balcony seats for the Sunday, Nov. 15, 2:00 p.m. Mountain Songs matinee are open through Nov. 10. The balcony uses two short stair flights; ground-floor exchanges are possible while aisle seats remain.

parameter.content: If Sahana still wants the Mountain Songs matinee, Kunsang Amla said she would enjoy coming with us. Sunday Nov. 15 at 2 works for her if we keep the outing simple.

parameter.title: Mountain Songs matinee with Kunsang Amla
parameter.description: Neighborhood outing: Sahana will buy tickets for herself, Nima and Kunsang. Pema already has a separate ground-floor ticket and will meet them inside; she is not part of Sahana’s three-ticket order.
parameter.location: Queens Community Arts Hall, Jackson Heights

parameter.description: Three discounted balcony matinee tickets for Sahana, Nima and Kunsang for Nov. 15 Mountain Songs. Pema has her own separate ground-floor admission.

parameter.subject: Order MSONG-BAL-4427 seating and exchange window
parameter.body: Your three tickets are Balcony Row B seats 7-9 for the Nov. 15 Mountain Songs matinee. If any guest needs ground-floor aisle seating, reply with the order number before 1:30 p.m. today; the box office can move all three guests on this order at no charge while the remaining aisle seats are held.

parameter.subject: MSONG-BAL-4427: opening missed at balcony access
parameter.body: The November 7 exchange hold expired at 13:30 without a request. Today Kunsang declined the two-flight balcony route at arrival; no ground-floor seat was available for this order at the 14:00 opening, so Sahana and Kunsang missed the opening while speaking with the access steward. Pema entered on her separate ground-floor ticket. Staff are still checking options for the remainder of the performance.
